notes: Copy to tests/fixtures/local-manifest.json and point path fields at local videos.
Never commit real videos or personal annotation exports.
Coordinates in annotations are upright SOURCE pixels (after display rotation).
Label times are frame presentation times: copy t from contact-sheet frames.json (npm run eval:contact-sheet).
Split by whole video/session: use split=tune|holdout — never split adjacent frames.
fps is the analysis sample rate; source frames are picked like the browser (sourceFrameSchedule). Optional per clip: sourceFps.

A clip passes when every labeled gate holds: impact timing (maxImpactErrorSec, 0.35 s), launch anchor (maxLaunchErrorPx, 60 px), every observed point from the first visible label to maxOvershootSec (0.1 s) past the last within maxTrackErrorPx (default 2% of the source long edge) of the label path (past the last label: its last segment, extended), flight recall >= minRecall (0.5), and no observed point more than maxOvershootSec past the last visible label or a later lastVisibleT.
Recall interpolates the observed track only across gaps up to maxGapSec (0.1 s): a label inside a longer gap is a miss.
Label the flight through lastVisibleT: observed points after the label margin but before lastVisibleT have no label to check them, so the clip cannot pass (unknown_ground_truth).
Recall counts visible labels at or after impactT. With impactT unset, every visible label counts, including the ball sitting at address.
A ball-visible annotation (visible frames or an addressBall) fails when the engine abstains; use expectAbstention or ballVisible: false for clips with no ball flight.
A missing or unparsable annotation file is reported as an error with its path.
